unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning small open-source LLMs on task-specific curated data for pre-consultation history taking
Evaluating pre-consultation history-of-present-illness completeness against diagnostic guidelines

screen.reason: The paper introduces EPAG, a benchmark framework and dataset to evaluate LLMs on pre-consultation tasks (HPI collection and diagnostic guidelines comparison). It evaluates models on a benchmark dataset without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
